environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on EC2 instance in a public subnet with an internet-facing ALB. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the target group on port 8080. Security group allows inbound from 0.0.0.0/0 on 443. Cookie SameSite attribute is not set (defaults to None in older browsers). No Origin/Referer header validation. Service accessible from any browser context.

config.alb: internet-facing, HTTPS listener, no managed rule groups
config.cookie_config: session_id cookie with Secure flag only, no SameSite attribute
